title: Add explicit Save and Cancel to the custom color picker
coverage: Explicit picker Save/Cancel, unchanged/invalid disabled state, local picker draft accepted into the existing staged settings draft; global Save remains the persistence boundary.

title: Use compact widths for wishlist theme choices
coverage: Compact centered palette choices with current/selected state; existing staged preview/global-save model retained.

title: Consolidate bulk actions into one categorized entry point
coverage: Categorized desktop cascading bulk actions and mobile overview → options → Back; all action categories, mixed/current/disabled/pending/error treatments and explicit copy destination are covered.

title: Reduce excessive spacing between filter checkbox options
coverage: Display → Filters: compact checkbox-option spacing, reachable final rows, fixed navigation clearance and scrolling only when content genuinely overflows. This issue is filter spacing, not the bulk-sheet header.

title: Align the bulk action sheet title count and close button
coverage: Mobile bulk-sheet header: selected count once beside Actions, close at right, aligned targets with adequate top/separator clearance; each current/mixed summary appears once. Hero Settings belongs to #359, not this issue.

title: Simplify wishlist display controls and move Settings into the hero
coverage: Single Display entry with persistent desktop parent and adjacent Sort/Group/Filter children; mobile in-sheet navigation retained. Existing options, role gates and accepted toolbar mask are preserved.

title: Allow Grid and List switching during manual reorder
coverage: Grid/List switching remains available in reorder with explicit Done; switching is not a save/exit action. Real dragging and persistence remain implementation verification.
